source_selection_rule: Prefer the responsible government agency for program rules and application requirements. Use 211-style/community directories for discovery and referral, then verify consequential qualifications with the responsible provider/agency.
security_rule: Do not place raw SSNs, passwords, identity-verification secrets, payment credentials or government portal credentials in benchmark artifacts.
truth_rule: A source being listed means Buddy knows where to verify; it does not mean every source is live-connected or every program/resource is currently available.
